name: 性能基线与异常检测诊断
description: 性能基线是正常运行状态的量化标准，是异常检测的基础。没有基线就无法区分 '异常' 和 '正常波动'。核心指标包括：QPS/TPS（吞吐量）、查询延迟分布（P99/P95）、连接数、线程活跃数、Buffer Pool 命中率、磁盘 IO、复制延迟。基线应按业务周期（日/周）建立，区分工作日/周末、高峰/低谷。告警阈值应基于基线的标准差而非固定值。

signals.desc: QPS 偏离基线超过 2 个标准差

conditions.desc: 任何核心指标偏离基线超过 2σ

skip_when.desc: 基线尚未建立（新实例运行不到 7 天）
正在执行已知的变更操作

root_causes.name: 未建立性能基线
root_causes.desc: 没有基线数据，所有告警都是拍脑袋设定的固定阈值。比如 QPS < 100 告警，但周末正常 QPS 就是 50。或者 Threads_running > 30 告警，但每天 14:00 批处理时正常就是 40。

root_causes.name: 基线未区分业务周期
root_causes.desc: 用全天均值作为基线，忽略高峰/低谷差异。白天 QPS=5000 和凌晨 QPS=200 的均值是 2600，但两个时段的 '正常' 范围完全不同。

root_causes.name: 告警阈值未随业务增长调整
root_causes.desc: 半年前设定的阈值没有更新。业务增长后 QPS 从 3000 涨到 6000，原来的告警阈值 8000 变得不再有效。

root_causes.name: 缺少关键监控指标
root_causes.desc: 只监控了 QPS 和连接数，缺少查询延迟分布、锁等待时间、Buffer Pool 命中率等关键指标。出了问题没有足够的数据来诊断。

step1_current_metrics.desc: 采集当前核心性能指标快照
step1_current_metrics.sql: SELECT (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME='Queries') AS total_queries, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME='Com_select') AS selects, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME='Com_insert') AS inserts, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME='Com_update') AS updates, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME='Com_delete') AS deletes, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME='Threads_connected') AS connections, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME='Threads_running') AS active_threads, (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME='Uptime') AS uptime_seconds

step2_qps_calculation.sql: SELECT ROUND((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME='Queries') / (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME='Uptime'), 1) AS avg_qps, ROUND((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME='Com_commit') / (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME='Uptime'), 1) AS avg_tps

step3_latency_distribution.desc: 查看查询延迟分布（通过 P_S events_statements_summary）
step3_latency_distribution.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN AVG_TIMER_WAIT < 1e9 THEN '< 1ms' WHEN AVG_TIMER_WAIT < 1e10 THEN '1-10ms' WHEN AVG_TIMER_WAIT < 1e11 THEN '10-100ms' WHEN AVG_TIMER_WAIT < 1e12 THEN '100ms-1s' ELSE '> 1s' END AS latency_bucket, COUNT(*) AS digest_count, SUM(COUNT_STAR) AS total_executions FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest GROUP BY latency_bucket ORDER BY MIN(AVG_TIMER_WAIT)

step4_key_status_vars.desc: 采集关键状态变量用于基线对比
step4_key_status_vars.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME IN ('Innodb_buffer_pool_reads', 'Innodb_buffer_pool_read_requests', 'Innodb_row_lock_waits', 'Innodb_row_lock_time_avg', 'Slow_queries', 'Sort_merge_passes', 'Created_tmp_disk_tables', 'Select_full_join', 'Handler_read_rnd_next', 'Innodb_data_reads', 'Innodb_data_writes')

step5_replication_lag.desc: 检查复制延迟（从库执行）
step5_replication_lag.sql: SELECT SERVICE_STATE, LAST_APPLIED_TRANSACTION_END_APPLY_TIMESTAMP, APPLYING_TRANSACTION_ORIGINAL_COMMIT_TIMESTAMP, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, APPLYING_TRANSACTION_ORIGINAL_COMMIT_TIMESTAMP, NOW()) AS lag_seconds FROM performance_schema.replication_applier_status_by_worker ORDER BY WORKER_ID LIMIT 1
step5_replication_lag.version_note: 8.0+ P_S 表提供更精确的延迟计算

real_world_examples.scenario: 告警 'QPS 低于 1000' 在周末频繁误报
real_world_examples.symptoms: 每个周末产生 20+ 条 QPS 过低告警。DBA 习惯性忽略，导致真正的故障告警也被忽略
real_world_examples.root_cause: 告警阈值 QPS < 1000 是按工作日高峰设定的固定值。周末正常 QPS 只有 300-500
real_world_examples.resolution: 建立分时段基线：工作日 9:00-18:00 基线 QPS=4000±500，周末基线 QPS=400±100。告警改为偏离基线 3σ 时触发
real_world_examples.result: 误告警从每周 20+ 降到 0，同时真正的异常（凌晨 QPS 突然归零）被及时发现
